source_quality.notes: the normalization, the entropy, the variation and the logistic fit were read from the raster; the text layer drops the fraction bars

task_reconstruction: Build an ecosystem service index from eleven indicators, grade projects by it, and compare the benefit-cost ratio with and without the ecosystem cost.

section_map.summary: the index, the grades and the factor
the cost and the fitted curve
the close, the strengths and the weaknesses

contributions.summary: an index weighted by entropy and by variation
three intensity grades with stated thresholds
a benefit-cost ratio with the ecosystem cost added
a sustainable development factor that grows with the project

dependency_graph.relation: the weights build the four groups
the index is what the grades cut
the index prices the ecosystem cost
the ratio is what the regression extends

assumptions.summary: the importance of the indicators does not change over time
the data are trusted because the sources are trusted
the ecosystem cost is proportional to the index
six of the eleven indicators count as sustainable

data_and_preprocessing.summary: the indicators are normalized in two directions
the weights are computed from the indicator values
the ratio of one project is tabulated by year

verification.summary: the grades matched to the known size of the projects
the forecast read as a longer life
the narrowing gap matched to a natural law

results_trace.summary: the pipeline grades strong and the house grades weak
the curves meet in 2026 and the uncounted case hits zero in 2033
the factor is largest for the national project

writing_logic.summary: the background closes on a question

the crossing is given a meaning
the suggestion concedes the cost first

language_observations.summary: opens with a slogan before the definition
rejects the deviation and offers the ratio
reads the forecast as a delayed decline
owns the limited data and the missing costs

visualization_observations.summary: the service system is drawn as a tree

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: narrating the fitted curve in three stages reads as a paper that wants the shape checked against the formula

weaknesses.summary: the proportion drops the indicator index
